summary: ActivityInterface defaults to an empty prefix, causing activity type name collisions when multiple activity classes share method names, potentially resulting in silent execution of the wrong implementation.
userImpact: Users registering multiple activity classes with shared method names may silently execute the wrong activity implementation without error, leading to incorrect workflow behavior.
rootCause: The default empty string for ActivityInterface::$prefix causes method names to be used as activity type names without class-based differentiation.
proposedFix: Default prefix to the short class name (e.g., 'ActivityA.') instead of an empty string, similar to Java SDK behavior.
workaround: Manually set prefix using #[ActivityInterface(prefix: 'classA.')] or explicitly name methods using #[ActivityMethod(name: 'classA.doWork')].
